formal_object.rationale: The object is a local trajectory error with Jacobian products, including cross-step and cross-frequency terms.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: C05: e_{t+1}=J_t e_t+delta_t+O(||e_t||^2). Condition: Differentiability and bounded second derivatives locally C04: e_T approximately sum_t product_(s>t) J_s delta_t. Condition: Keep order and all cross terms

derivation.rationale: Linear error propagation follows the local recursion; projecting frequency bands does not annihilate arbitrary cross terms.

assumptions.rationale: F_t is differentiable in a specified trajectory neighborhood; local remainder is controlled. A Fourier projector alone does not commute with spatial/temporal Jacobians. Native motion/quality are not measured by latent terminal norm alone. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: No frequency-dependent controller that suppresses error while preserving original motion is constructed. Smoothing is not an adequate method definition.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: A future valid intervention would need a frequency-dependent error/cost law that a budget-matched smoothing baseline does not explain. Falsification: Reduced latent error with degraded official motion/quality or ordinary smoothing matching the effect defeats the explanation.

closest_alternative.rationale: Video smoothing, distillation and caching can explain apparent error reductions; the motion-quality boundary is still undefined. This check only reviews the stated mathematical comparison; exhaustive full-text/author-code/native collision and originality decisions remain pending.

review_independence: Single-agent self-review; not a blinded/independent novelty or empirical review.
claim_scope: Conditional formal construction only. No code/test/design/result/native-parent qualification.
